title: steady timecode readout width
description:
Owner round 3a (2026-11-11): during playback the transport strip's
timecode label swayed left-right continuously — the frame field ticks
~24x/s and the label is the Row's last non-weighted element, so every
width change shifted both the label's left edge and the weighted
slider beside it. The format is fixed-width and the style already
merges tnum, but the device font ignores the tnum tabular-figures
feature: proportional digits (narrow "1", wide "8") oscillate the
label's natural width. The fix is font-independent by construction.

- TransportRow measures the readout's worst case ONCE with the exact
  TextStyle it renders with (labelMedium.merge(Tnum), hoisted so the
  measure and the Text share one object) via rememberTextMeasurer,
  and pins the Text with Modifier.widthIn(min = measured). The
  measured value is the max over Format.timecodeWidthProbes() — the
  uniform-digit variants
